panels.title: Job queue depth
panels.description: Queued vs running jobs over time, from the app's own jobs table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval), count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='queued') AS queued, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='running') AS running FROM jobs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failed jobs per interval
panels.description: Jobs that ended in status 'failed'. Rising failures mean a job type is broken, not that the server is slow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at,$__interval), count(*) FROM jobs WHERE status='failed' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Media items with failed analysis
panels.description: Non-deleted media items whose analysis never succeeded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS failed FROM media_item WHERE analysis_status='failed' AND deleted = false

panels.title: Jobs finished per interval by type
panels.description: Throughput of completed work, split by job type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at,$__interval), job_type, count(*) FROM jobs WHERE status='done' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most common failure reasons
panels.description: Grouped jobs.last_error: what actually broke, most frequent first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT last_error, count(*) AS occurrences, max(finished_at) AS last_seen FROM jobs WHERE status='failed' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY last_error ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Error log volume
panels.description: Count of ERROR lines in the shipped JSON logs.

panels.title: Backend log stream
panels.description: Every line, including request spans. Use `| json` to filter on any field.
